consumer: An engine visibility query asking the yes/no 'does the avatar at F have line of sight to nearby tile T within sight range?', as computed by map::sees(F,T,range)
scope: A from->to reachability check from the avatar's own tile to the one given nearby target tile, bounded by sight range (not a whole map region, not carried inventory)
decisive_source: src/map.cpp::map::sees(F,T,range) — its body delegates to the four-argument sees() overload and returns the engine-computed boolean for whether T is visible/reachable from F within range
divergence: Place a solid wall on the straight line between the avatar's tile and the target tile that is within range: map::sees returns false (LOS blocked), while any answer derived only from distance/range or from raw terrain ids would wrongly report true
